about: Kit pages for the validation set, read 2026-11-18 in the owner's Chrome from a homedepot.com tab with fetch('/p/<itemId>') (no SerpApi); item ids found with Home Depot's own search for the kit model. ProductPage form, bullets filtered as in pages-2026-11-18.json. The four the harness asked for (DCK200D1P1, DCK540D1, DCK225D2, PCL1201K2) plus the kits of the six DEWALT forms found unread (DCK420D2, DCK240C2, DCK316ST2M1, DCK940D2). Most DEWALT kit pages carry no Includes list.
